summary: The implementation successfully addresses all core requirements for replacing the bullet splitting engine with smart semantic splitting. The new engine in notesCleanerFormat.ts implements protected compound term detection, complete sentence preservation, validation rules, and semantic grouping. However, the diff is truncated, preventing full verification of: (1) complete removal of old logic (REQ-1), (2) all three conversion modes using the new engine (REQ-6), and (3) detailed implementation of sequential phrase splitting (REQ-3).
